remove_cmd.description: Command used to remove packages (with purge).

info_cmd.description: Command used to display package information.

keeper_file.description: Path to the file storing the list of kept/orphaned packages.

max_priority.description: Highest priority level to ask questions about. Possible values: required, important, standard, optional, extra, or ANY.

use_hold.description: Consider packages marked with 'hold' status as keepers.

use_essential.description: Consider packages marked 'Essential: yes' as keepers.

use_tasks.description: Treat tasksel tasks as regular packages (prefixed 'task-').

keep_sections.description: Comma-separated list of package sections to always keep.

nokeep_sections.description: Comma-separated list of package sections to never keep.

guess_depends.description: Comma-separated list of suffixes to treat as dependencies of the base package name.

negative_keepers.description: Whether to respect negative entries (explicit removals) in the keeper file.

verbose.description: Enable verbose output (same as -v on command line).

force.description: Force non-interactive mode, answering 'No' to all questions (same as -f).
